rationale: A coherent third-channel extension of the archive's two best performers (HiddenCapitalWeightedSolvencyRestatement and the composition discriminator), but the nested SUMRANK gives the never-significant composition channel half the discriminator weight while diluting the proven add-back and maturity channels to a quarter each, so it risks weakening the slope it is meant to preserve.

This is a legitimate weight-versus-channel placement test that has been informative elsewhere in this archive, but the new conditioner RANK(xrd5/at − gdwl/at) is highly correlated with the already-tested RANK(xrd5/lt) weight, so the incremental information over HiddenCapitalWeightedSolvencyRestatement is likely small.

Internally consistent in sign and a genuine mirror-side exposure swap (goodwill rather than organic intangibles) relative to DeteriorationMeetingMaturingDebt, though the working-capital-growth-minus-sales-growth channel is close to the published accruals/NOA anomaly and the goodwill weight is heavily tied at zero, so any result will need an accruals control.

The stated motivation is internally inconsistent — the parent's difference-of-stocks channel is already cross-sectionally ranked inside SUMRANK, so "fat-tailed dispersion dominating the ordering" cannot explain the flat slope — leaving this as a minor rescaling of an evaluated signal that additionally introduces 0/0 undefined values and coverage loss for firms with neither R&D nor goodwill.

This cleanly fills an untested cell in the conditioner ladder by pairing the archive's highest-Sharpe deficit weight with the proven add-back-plus-maturity discriminator, and the stock-versus-flow contrast against LossAddBackWithoutRefinancingNeed is a genuinely diagnostic comparison rather than a cosmetic variant.

Substituting a one-year operating-trajectory channel for the maturity channel under the hidden-capital conditioner combines non-overlapping accounting information from the archive's strongest long and short channels, with correct sign alignment, though the claim that this will fix turnover/Sharpe rather than magnitude is asserted rather than argued.
